page.title: Janitor
page.caption: Removes what's left behind: stale task containers, dangling images and orphaned networks. Never volumes, never anything running.
page.cleanNowHint: Shows what would be removed first.
page.noNode: No node is reporting, so there is nothing TierPlan can check.

error.title: Couldn't load the janitor.
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

lock.waiting: Waiting for a deploy to finish. {{stack}} is deploying.

refused.deploy: A deploy is running in {{env}}. Try again when it finishes.
refused.janitor: The janitor is already cleaning {{env}}. Try again when it finishes.

start.title: Couldn't start the cleanup.
start.body: Try again. If it keeps failing, check the Janitor page for a run before you do.

reason.task_beyond_keep: Exited task, {{rank}} oldest of service {{service}} slot {{slot}}.
reason.task_beyond_keep_global: Exited task, {{rank}} oldest of service {{service}} on {{node}}.
reason.task_service_gone: Exited task of service {{service}}, which no longer exists.
reason.network_orphaned: Orphaned: the stack {{stack}} that created it no longer exists.
reason.network_unused: Unused: no stack created it and nothing uses it.
reason.opt_in_off_containers: Opt-in off: stopped standalone containers aren't removed until you turn that on.
reason.opt_in_off_networks: Opt-in off: unused networks aren't removed until you turn that on.
reason.lone_compose_container: Stopped container of compose project {{project}}, which still exists.
reason.kept_row: Protected: you chose Keep on it.
reason.stack_excluded: Protected: stack {{stack}} is excluded from the janitor.
reason.stack_declared_keep: Protected: stack {{stack}} sets tierplan.keep=true in its compose file.
reason.younger_than_grace: Younger than the grace period: {{time}} left.
reason.networks_withheld: Can't tell yet: TierPlan won't judge networks while a node isn't reporting.
reason.stack_unknown: Can't tell yet: TierPlan couldn't work out which stack owns it.
reason.inspect_capped: Left alone: its details are over 64 KB, too large to save in the audit log first.
reason.clock_skew: Can't tell yet: the node's clock is out of step with TierPlan's.
reason.task_labels_missing: Can't tell yet: it has no swarm task labels, so TierPlan can't place it.
reason.services_unread: Can't tell yet: no manager answered, so TierPlan can't tell which services still exist.
reason.node_disabled: Protected: the janitor is turned off for {{node}}.

preview.title: Clean up {{env}}
preview.description: This is what the janitor would remove now, using this environment's policy. Untick anything you want to leave.

summary.sizeTooltip: An estimate from image sizes and the size of each container's writable layer. The real amount freed can differ.

preview.withheldNetworks: TierPlan won't judge networks while {{nodes}} isn't reporting.
preview.withheldNetworksNoManager: TierPlan won't judge networks because no manager answered.

notRemoved.title: Not removed ({{count}})
notRemoved.caption: Reported only, or protected. Nothing here is touched.

empty.title: Nothing to clean up
empty.body: No stale task containers, dangling images or orphaned networks older than the grace period. Anything the policy only reports is listed under Not removed.

error.title: Couldn't work out what to clean up.
error.body: Check the connection and try again. Nothing was removed.

footer.note: TierPlan checks each item again just before it removes it, and keeps any that something started using. The details of each network and container are saved first. Volumes are never touched.
footer.tickOne: Tick at least one item to remove.
